title: Selection Rules
description: Essential Criteria: State the correct electric-dipole selection rules for atomic transitions.

title: Photon Properties
description: Important Criteria: Explain the selection rules in terms of photon orbital angular momentum, spin, helicity, and parity.

title: Power Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Derive the power radiated using the classical formula and express it correctly in terms of the required variables.

title: Lifetime Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: Calculate the lifetime of the 2p state using the derived power and energy difference.

title: Width Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Determine the width of the 2p state in electron volts from the lifetime.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of selection rules.
